# superset_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a dashboard in Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "example" {
  dashboard_title = "Sales Overview"
  slug            = "sales-overview"
  published       = true
}
```

### Dashboard with Custom CSS

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "styled" {
  dashboard_title = "Executive Dashboard"
  slug            = "exec-dashboard"
  published       = true
  css             = <<-EOF
    .dashboard-header {
      background-color: #1a1a2e;
    }
    .chart-container {
      border-radius: 8px;
    }
  EOF
}
```

### Dashboard with Certification

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "certified" {
  dashboard_title       = "Financial Reports"
  slug                  = "financial-reports"
  published             = true
  certified_by          = "Finance Team"
  certification_details = "Approved for Q4 2024 reporting"
}
```

### Minimal Dashboard (Required Fields Only)

```terraform
resource "superset_dashboard" "minimal" {
  dashboard_title = "My Dashboard"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_title` (String) The title of the dashboard.

### Optional

- `certification_details` (String) Details of the certification.
- `certified_by` (String) Person or group that has certified this dashboard.
- `css` (String) Custom CSS to override the dashboard's styling.
- `json_metadata` (String) JSON object containing dashboard metadata such as filter configurations, default filters, and chart refresh settings. Generated by Superset's dashboard builder.
- `position_json` (String) JSON object describing the positioning of widgets/charts in the dashboard. This defines the dashboard layout and is typically generated by the dashboard editor.
- `published` (Boolean) Determines whether or not this dashboard is visible in the list of dashboards. Defaults to `false`.
- `slug` (String) Unique identifying part for the web address of the dashboard. If not provided, Superset will generate one from the title.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Dashboard can be imported by specifying the numeric identifier of the Dashboard id
terraform import superset_dashboard.example 123
```
